quests.instruction: DESCRIBE THE STEPS IN ORDER
quests.situation: You want a hot cup of tea before starting work. Describe the steps you follow to make it, from beginning to end.
quests.hint: Put the steps in the order you actually do them, and use one sequence word to link two of the steps.
quests.explanation: Process writing works best when each sentence moves the reader one step forward. A single sequence word, such as then, is often enough to show the order clearly.
quests.modelAnswer: First, I fill the kettle with water and put it on the stove. Once it boils, I pour the water over a teabag in my cup. Then I let it steep for a few minutes before drinking it.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU GET DRESSED FOR WORK
quests.situation: Every weekday morning, you follow the same order when getting dressed for work. Describe the steps you take.
quests.hint: List the clothing items in the order you put them on, and check yourself in the mirror near the end.
quests.explanation: A routine becomes clear writing when each garment appears in the order it is worn. Ending with a check, like looking in a mirror, shows the process is complete.
quests.modelAnswer: I put on my ironed shirt and button it up, then pull on a pair of socks from the drawer. After that, I tie my shoes and check myself quickly in the mirror before heading out.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU LEAVE YOUR APARTMENT SAFELY
quests.situation: Before you leave your apartment each morning, you check a few things to make sure everything is safe. Describe the steps you take.
quests.hint: Order the checks logically, from inside the apartment to the final action of locking the door.
quests.explanation: A safety routine is a process with a clear final step, such as locking the door. Writing the checks in the order they happen makes the habit easy to follow and repeat.
quests.modelAnswer: Before I leave, I check that the stove is off and turn off the lights in every room. Next, I make sure my phone and wallet are in my pocket, and finally I lock the door behind me.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE THE LAUNDRY PROCESS FROM START TO FINISH
quests.situation: On Saturday mornings, you do a full load of laundry. Describe the process from sorting the clothes to putting them away.
quests.hint: Move through four clear stages: sorting, washing, drying, and putting the clothes away.
quests.explanation: A longer process needs clear stage markers so the reader does not lose track. Four short, connected sentences usually work better here than one long, crowded sentence.
quests.modelAnswer: First, I sort the clothes into light and dark piles. Then I load the washer with detergent and start the cycle. Once it finishes, I move everything to the dryer, and afterward I fold each piece and put it in the drawers.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU MAKE A SIMPLE SALAD
quests.situation: You are making a quick vegetable salad for lunch. Describe the steps you follow to prepare it.
quests.hint: Describe the preparation of each vegetable before you describe combining them in the bowl.
quests.explanation: In recipe-style writing, preparing each ingredient separately before combining them mirrors how the task is actually done, which helps the reader follow along step by step.
quests.modelAnswer: I wash the lettuce leaves and tear them into a large bowl. Next, I slice a cucumber and dice a tomato on the cutting board. Once everything is chopped, I add it to the bowl and toss it together.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU PACK FOR A WEEKEND TRIP
quests.situation: You are packing a small suitcase for a two-day trip. Describe the order in which you pack your things.
quests.hint: Start with the suitcase itself, then move through clothes, toiletries, and finally small electronics.
quests.explanation: Packing lists become better writing when grouped by category rather than listed randomly. Grouping similar items together, like all clothing first, keeps each sentence focused.
quests.modelAnswer: I lay my open suitcase on the bed and start with folded clothes for two days. Then I add a small bag of toiletries and zip it shut. Last, I tuck my phone charger into a side pocket.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU SET UP A NEW PHONE
quests.situation: You just bought a new phone and need to set it up before using it. Describe the steps you follow.
quests.hint: Follow the natural order: unboxing, charging, connecting to the internet, and signing in.
quests.explanation: A technical setup process reads clearly when broken into short verified steps, each one completed before the next begins. This structure works for almost any device setup.
quests.modelAnswer: I take the phone out of the box and let it charge for a few minutes before turning it on. Once it powers up, I connect it to my home wifi and sign in with my account details.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU ASSEMBLE A NEW BOOKSHELF
quests.situation: You bought a flat-pack bookshelf that needs assembly. Describe the steps you take to put it together.
quests.hint: Mention checking the instructions before starting, then describe attaching the parts, and end by checking your work.
quests.explanation: Assembly instructions benefit from a check at the beginning and the end, showing that the writer confirmed the plan before starting and confirmed the result afterward.
quests.modelAnswer: First, I lay out all the wooden panels and read through the printed instructions carefully. Then I attach the side boards with a screwdriver, following the diagram step by step. When it is finished, I shake it gently to check it is steady.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU USE A SELF-CHECKOUT MACHINE
quests.situation: You are buying a few items at a self-checkout machine in a supermarket. Describe the steps you follow to pay.
quests.hint: Describe scanning each item, then choosing a payment method, and finish with the receipt.
quests.explanation: A machine-based process is easy to describe when each screen prompt leads naturally to the next action. Keeping the steps in the order the machine actually presents them avoids confusion.
quests.modelAnswer: I scan each item one by one, and the machine beeps to confirm the price. After scanning everything, I touch the screen to choose card payment and tap my card on the reader. Finally, I take the printed receipt.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE YOUR MORNING WORKOUT ROUTINE
quests.situation: You exercise for thirty minutes every morning before breakfast. Describe your workout routine from warm-up to finish.
quests.hint: Move through the three natural stages of a workout: warming up, the main exercise, and cooling down afterward.
quests.explanation: Fitness routines follow a natural structure of preparation, main activity, and recovery. Describing all three stages, rather than only the middle one, gives a fuller picture of the process.
quests.modelAnswer: I start by stretching my legs and arms for five minutes to warm up. Then I jog on the treadmill for twenty minutes and lift some light weights. Afterward, I stretch again and take a shower to cool down.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU PREPARE FOR A JOB INTERVIEW
quests.situation: You have a job interview at ten this morning. Describe the steps you take to prepare before you leave home.
quests.hint: Include both physical preparation, like clothes, and mental preparation, like practicing answers.
quests.explanation: Preparation for an important event often includes practical steps and mental steps together. Showing both types gives a more complete and realistic description of getting ready.
quests.modelAnswer: I iron my shirt the night before and print two extra copies of my resume in the morning. While getting dressed, I practice a few answers out loud in front of the mirror, and I leave the house early to arrive on time.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU CARE FOR YOUR HOUSEPLANTS EACH WEEK
quests.situation: Every Sunday, you check on your houseplants and take care of them. Describe your weekly plant care routine.
quests.hint: Describe checking the plants first, then the specific actions you take based on what you find.
quests.explanation: A checking step before an action step, such as touching the soil before watering, shows the reader that the routine is thoughtful rather than automatic.
quests.modelAnswer: Every Sunday, I touch the soil in each pot to see if it feels dry. If it does, I water the plants with a small jug, and I trim off any yellow leaves I notice. Finally, I move a few pots closer to the window for more sunlight.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU APPLIED FOR A LIBRARY CARD
quests.situation: You went to your local library to get a library card for the first time. Describe the process from arriving to receiving the card.
quests.hint: Follow the order of a real registration process: approaching the desk, filling a form, showing identification, and receiving the card.
quests.explanation: Registration processes often repeat across daily life, so learning to describe one, such as getting a library card, transfers easily to similar situations like opening a bank account.
quests.modelAnswer: I walked up to the front desk and asked the librarian how to register. She gave me a short form to fill in with my name and address, and I showed my identification card as proof. A few minutes later, she handed me my new library card.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU RETURNED AN ONLINE ORDER
quests.situation: An item you ordered online did not fit, so you needed to return it. Describe the steps you followed to send it back.
quests.hint: Describe the online part of the process first, then the physical steps of preparing and sending the package.
quests.explanation: Many modern processes combine an online stage and a physical stage. Separating the two clearly, first the website, then the package, helps the reader understand the full process.
quests.modelAnswer: I logged into the website and requested a return, which let me print a shipping label at home. Then I repacked the item in its original box, taped it shut, and stuck the label on top before dropping it off at the post office.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU PREPARED A CLASS PRESENTATION
quests.situation: You had to prepare a five-minute presentation for a university class. Describe the steps you took from research to the final rehearsal.
quests.hint: Move through research, building the slides, writing what you will say, and practicing out loud.
quests.explanation: Academic tasks often have four stages: gathering information, organizing it, writing it out, and rehearsing. Naming each stage briefly gives the reader a sense of real preparation.
quests.modelAnswer: I spent an evening researching the topic and taking notes from three reliable sources. The next day, I built five simple slides and wrote a short script for each one. Before class, I rehearsed the whole presentation twice, timing myself with my phone.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU CHANGED A FLAT TIRE
quests.situation: Your car got a flat tire on the side of the road. Describe the steps you followed to change it.
quests.hint: Begin with the safety step, then describe lifting the car, removing the wheel, and attaching the spare.
quests.explanation: Practical processes involving safety, such as changing a tire, usually start with a safety step before the main task. Mentioning it first shows careful, realistic behavior.
quests.modelAnswer: I turned on my hazard lights and pulled the car safely onto the shoulder. Using the jack, I lifted the car and loosened the bolts on the flat tire. After removing it, I attached the spare wheel and tightened every bolt firmly.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU SET UP A TENT WHILE CAMPING
quests.situation: You arrived at a campsite in the evening and needed to set up your tent before dark. Describe the steps you followed.
quests.hint: Describe clearing the ground first, then assembling the poles, and finish with securing the tent for the night.
quests.explanation: Outdoor tasks often depend on the environment, so mentioning a detail like clearing stones from the ground grounds the process in a specific, believable place.
quests.modelAnswer: First, I cleared away a few stones and sticks from the ground where the tent would go. Then I slid the poles together and pushed them through the fabric loops. Once the tent stood up, I hammered the stakes into the soil and hung a small lantern inside.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU BAKED COOKIES FROM A RECIPE
quests.situation: You decided to bake chocolate chip cookies using an online recipe. Describe the steps you followed from mixing to taking them out of the oven.
quests.hint: Follow the recipe stages: mixing the ingredients, shaping the cookies, and baking them for the right amount of time.
quests.explanation: Recipes are one of the clearest examples of process writing, since each stage depends completely on the one before it. This makes them useful practice for logical, dependent sequencing.
quests.modelAnswer: I mixed the butter, sugar, and flour together in a bowl until it formed a smooth batter, then stirred in a handful of chocolate chips. After preheating the oven, I scooped small balls of dough onto a tray and baked them for twelve minutes until they turned golden.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU SORT YOUR RECYCLING AT HOME
quests.situation: Every Wednesday evening, you sort your household waste before collection day. Describe the process you follow.
quests.hint: Group the waste by material type, and mention one small preparation step for at least one type, like rinsing.
quests.explanation: Sorting tasks are naturally organized by category. Describing one category at a time, with a small detail like rinsing bottles, makes the process feel practical rather than abstract.
quests.modelAnswer: Every Wednesday, I take out three different bins and separate the waste by material. I rinse out plastic bottles before placing them in one bin, and I flatten cardboard boxes for another. Glass jars go into a separate container after a quick wash.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU SUBMITTED AN ASSIGNMENT ONLINE
quests.situation: You had to submit a written assignment through your university's online portal before midnight. Describe the steps you followed.
quests.hint: Move from preparing the file, to logging in, to uploading it, and finish with checking for confirmation.
quests.explanation: Digital submission processes usually end with a confirmation step. Including that final check reassures the reader, and yourself, that the process actually worked.
quests.modelAnswer: I saved my essay as a PDF and made sure the file name matched the instructions. Then I logged into the course portal and clicked the upload button next to the assignment. After uploading it, I waited for the confirmation message before closing my laptop.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU BREW COFFEE WITH A FRENCH PRESS
quests.situation: You are making a pot of coffee using a French press at home. Describe the process from grinding the beans to pouring the coffee.
quests.hint: Describe grinding, adding water, waiting, and finally pressing down and pouring, in that exact order.
quests.explanation: A process with a waiting period, like steeping coffee, needs a clear time marker such as four minutes to show why nothing happens during that stage.
quests.modelAnswer: I grind a scoop of coffee beans to a coarse texture and pour them into the French press. Then I add hot water and let it steep for four minutes. Finally, I push the plunger down slowly and pour the coffee into my mug.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE THE STEPS OF GETTING A HAIRCUT
quests.situation: You go to a hair salon for a scheduled appointment. Describe the process from checking in to paying at the end.
quests.hint: Describe checking in, sitting in the chair, the actual haircut, and finish with paying.
quests.explanation: Service appointments follow a predictable shape: arrival, the main service, and payment. Recognizing this shape helps you describe almost any appointment, from a haircut to a dentist visit.
quests.modelAnswer: At the salon, I check in at the reception desk and give my name. The stylist wraps a cape around me and asks what style I want before starting to trim my hair. When she finishes, I pay at the counter and leave a small tip.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU FILLED OUT A FORM AT A GOVERNMENT OFFICE
quests.situation: You visited a government office to renew an official document. Describe the process from taking a number to leaving with your paperwork.
quests.hint: Include the waiting stage explicitly, since it is often the longest part of this kind of process.
quests.explanation: Bureaucratic processes almost always include a waiting stage. Mentioning it honestly, rather than skipping to the end, makes the description more realistic and useful.
quests.modelAnswer: I took a numbered ticket from a machine near the entrance and filled in a form while I waited. After nearly forty minutes, my number was called, and a clerk checked my documents. She stamped the papers, and I signed where she pointed before leaving with my renewed document.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU SET UP A VIDEO CALL FOR WORK
quests.situation: You need to set up a video call with a client for the first time using new software. Describe the steps you followed.
quests.hint: Cover the technical setup first, then the communication step of sending the link, and finish with a final check.
quests.explanation: Technology-related processes often combine setup, communication, and a last-minute check. Writing all three stages shows the reader that the process was managed carefully.
quests.modelAnswer: First, I downloaded the video call software and created an account. Then I scheduled the meeting in my calendar and emailed the client a link to join. Just before the call, I tested my microphone and camera to make sure everything worked properly.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOUR FAMILY PREPARED A HOLIDAY MEAL
quests.situation: Your family spent the whole afternoon preparing a large holiday meal together. Describe the process from planning to serving the food.
quests.hint: Show how the cooking was divided between different dishes before everything came together on the table.
quests.explanation: Large processes often run in parallel, with several tasks happening at the same time rather than strictly one after another. Showing this parallel structure reflects how real cooking for a big meal actually works.
quests.modelAnswer: In the morning, we decided on the menu and wrote a shopping list together. While the turkey roasted slowly in the oven, my mother stirred a pot of soup and my aunt prepared the side dishes. By evening, we arranged everything on the table and finally sat down to eat.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU ORGANIZED A STUDY SESSION BEFORE AN EXAM
quests.situation: You have an important exam in three days, so you plan a structured study session. Describe the process from organizing your materials to reviewing what you learned.
quests.hint: Describe organizing your materials first, then studying in blocks, and finish with reviewing what you covered.
quests.explanation: Planning-based processes benefit from a clear structure: preparation, execution, and review. This three-part shape works for almost any task that requires focused effort over time.
quests.modelAnswer: I gathered my notes and textbook and made a short list of the topics I found hardest. Using a timer, I studied in forty-minute blocks with short breaks between them. At the end of the session, I reviewed my notes once more and wrote a brief summary of each topic.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE HOW YOU CLEANED THE HOUSE BEFORE GUESTS ARRIVED
quests.situation: Friends are coming to visit in two hours, and your house needs cleaning. Describe the process you followed to get everything ready in time.
quests.hint: Prioritize the most visible tasks first, since there is limited time before the guests arrive.
quests.explanation: When a process has a time limit, prioritizing which steps matter most shows practical thinking. Mentioning the deadline itself, like two hours, adds useful pressure to the description.
quests.modelAnswer: With only two hours before my friends arrived, I started by vacuuming the living room carpet and wiping down every visible surface. Next, I cleaned the streaky windows near the entrance. By the time the doorbell rang, the house looked presentable, if not perfectly clean.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE THE FULL PROCESS OF MOVING INTO A NEW APARTMENT
quests.situation: You are moving into a new apartment today. Describe the entire process from picking up the keys to unpacking your first box, including any small problems that come up along the way.
quests.hint: Organize the day into clear stages, and mention one small unexpected difficulty that you had to solve as you went.
quests.explanation: Longer real-world processes rarely go perfectly, so including one small complication, and how you handled it, makes a sequence feel authentic rather than mechanically ideal.
quests.modelAnswer: I collected the keys from the rental agent in the morning and found the empty apartment covered in dust. After sweeping the floors, I spent the afternoon carrying boxes up three flights of stairs, since the elevator was out of service. By evening, I had arranged the sofa and unpacked the first box of kitchen items.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE THE FULL PROCESS OF PREPARING AND DELIVERING A CLASS PRESENTATION
quests.situation: You had a presentation due for your history class. Describe the entire process, from your first research session to actually delivering it in front of your classmates.
quests.hint: Cover the research and preparation briefly, then spend more detail on the moment of actually presenting.
quests.explanation: When summarizing a whole process, it often helps to describe earlier stages more briefly and give the climax, such as delivering the talk, more detailed attention.
quests.modelAnswer: I spent two evenings in the library gathering information for my presentation and building ten simple slides afterward. On the day of the talk, I stood in front of the class with shaking hands and spoke for exactly five minutes. When my classmates applauded at the end, I finally felt relieved.

quests.instruction: DESCRIBE A SATURDAY MORNING OF RUNNING SEVERAL ERRANDS
quests.situation: You had four separate errands to complete on Saturday morning before noon. Describe the whole process, including the order you chose and how you managed your time.
quests.hint: Explain why you chose that particular order for your errands, based on distance or opening times.
quests.explanation: Multi-stop processes are clearer when the writer explains the reasoning behind the order, such as visiting the closest place first. This turns a simple list of stops into an organized plan.
quests.modelAnswer: Since the bank opened earliest, I went there first to deposit a check before the queue grew long. I then cycled to the post office to send a package, and stopped at the market on the way back for fresh vegetables. By eleven thirty, I had finished all four errands and returned home in time for lunch.
